full_judgment: 26. From the aforesaid observations made by the Appeal Officer, it is found that Azahar Ali Mridha produced cheque dakhila before the Settlement Officer and Appeal Officer showing payment of rents to Rezia Khatun. Modified SA Khatian No. 1364/1 (Exhibit-Ka) supports the observations made by the Appeal Officer which was modified under Section 46 of the SAT Act, 1950 recognizing Azahar Ali Mridha as direct tenant under the government showing Rezia Khatun owner of the property as landlord under her Azahar Ali Mridha was agricultural tenant. Therefore, contention of the petitioners that the SA khatian has no basis at all has no substance and fact of acquiring title as agricultural tenant under Rezia Khatun was established in objection case and appeal case and it was also established that Azahar Ali Mridha was in possession. Fact of the cases referred by the learned Advocate for the petitioners regarding basis of SA and RS khatian are totally different from the fact of the present case. Both the courts below concurrently observed and found that recording of SA khatian and RS khatian in the name of Azahar Ali Mridha has basis and the documents like rent receipts showing payment of rents right from 1957 till today (Exhibit-Kha series), judgment and order of the Appeal Officer (Exhibit Umo-3), Advocate Commissioner report (Exhibit-Chha), notice of acquisition of property (Exhibits Umo-1 and 2) and the evidences led by defendants as DWs all corroborate each other supporting title of the defendants in the suit property.
